AiSettings.title: AI settings
AiSettings.intro: Providers, models, budget and data protection of the assistant. Every change revokes an existing release.
AiSettings.apiKeyHint: The key is only written and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
AiSettings.modelsHint: Prices in EUR per one million tokens, according to the contract with the provider. Empty tiers are not saved.
AiSettings.tierInvalid: Tier {tier}: specify the model and both prices.
AiSettings.maxOutputHint: Output limit of the model according to the provider, in tokens per answer. Empty means 16000.
AiSettings.maxOutputInvalid: Tier {tier}: the output limit must be an integer greater than 0.
AiSettings.testHint: Sends a minimal prompt to the provider for each configured tier (small, large). The test neither requires nor grants a release; the costs are minimal and are charged to the monthly budget.
AiSettings.testUnsaved: Please save first, the test uses the saved configuration.
AiSettings.budgetInvalid: Please enter a valid monthly budget, for example 100.00.
AiSettings.optOut: Exclusion from use for training confirmed
AiSettings.dataProtectionHint: These details do not replace a review of the contract. The release requires DPA, DPA document, training opt-out, API key and budget.
AiSettings.saved: Saved. The release must be granted again.
AiSettings.fourEyesHint: Four eyes principle: the release must be granted by a different person than the one who last saved.
AiSettings.usageWarning: Attention: 80 percent of the monthly budget has been reached.
AiSettings.usageBlocked: The monthly budget is exhausted. New requests are blocked.
AiSettings.openaiHint: Both providers are only used after release under the four eyes principle and with a proven DPA. Model names: for OpenAI for example gpt-4.1 or gpt-4o, for Anthropic for example claude-sonnet-4-5.

routingHint.anthropic_first: Anthropic answers all requests. If the monthly budget of Anthropic is exhausted or the provider reports an error, OpenAI takes over automatically.
routingHint.openai_first: OpenAI answers all requests. If the monthly budget of OpenAI is exhausted or the provider reports an error, Anthropic takes over automatically.
routingHint.alternate: Requests alternate between both providers. If one fails or its budget is exhausted, the other takes over.
routingHint.anthropic_only: Only Anthropic is used. If the budget is exhausted, new requests are blocked, there is no switch.
routingHint.openai_only: Only OpenAI is used. If the budget is exhausted, new requests are blocked, there is no switch.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.intro: Filing rules, workflows, corrections and facts per tenant and optionally per property. Used as context in AI runs, never written automatically.

ImmowareLists.title: Immoware24 Listenimport
ImmowareLists.intro: Keep the order: 1. properties and units, 2. contacts, 3. owner and tenant assignment. In each section run a test first, then apply. Files as CSV (UTF-8, semicolon) from Immoware24.

objektdaten.title: 1. Properties and units
objektdaten.help: Export of property data with the columns Objekt-Nummer, Objekt, Verwaltungsart, VE-Nummer. Owners, tenants and amounts are only stored as a source note on the unit.
objektdaten.numberMap: Number mapping (OLD=NEW, one per line or separated by commas)
objektdaten.numberMapHelp: For property numbers with more than three digits, for example 10012=012.
objektdaten.skipHandedOver: Skip handed over properties (prefix Z ABGEGEBEN)

kontakte.title: 2. Contacts
kontakte.help: One list per contact group (columns id and Name required). The role is prefilled from the file name and can be changed. The same contact in several lists receives all roles.

ImmowareLists.applyHint: Apply is enabled after a test run with the same files and settings.
ImmowareLists.resultApplied: Applied. The run is listed under imports.

zuordnung.title: 3. Owner and tenant assignment
zuordnung.help: Object list as in step 1. Owners and tenants are matched by name to the imported contacts and created as contracts with a monthly payment. Existing contracts are never overwritten, ambiguous names are only reported.
zuordnung.startDateHelp: Default is 1 January of the current year.

ImmowareLists.noPermission: Missing permission for the list import (create imports and create properties, contacts and contracts).

Payments.title: Payment orders
Payments.notice: Approval by two different people. Any change voids approvals. The payment file is only created with release gate G2; export or submission never counts as payment.

Dunning.title: Dunning
Dunning.notice: Dunning runs start as preview. A second person must approve. Only the leading system may dun; while Immoware24 leads, all cases are excluded.
Dunning.feesLocked: A dunning fee or statutory interest only applies once the operator has entered an amount, or a Basiszinssatz, for that level (operator decision 25.09.2026, V7 partly decided). Without a value the item stays 0.00 EUR.
Dunning.confirmApprove: Approve this dunning run now? Approval cannot be undone.
Dunning.mahnbescheidHint: Preparation only, for review by a lawyer. The platform never files this itself.
Dunning.mahnbescheidOnlyHighest: Only possible on the highest configured level.
Dunning.settingsTitle: Dunning levels, fees and statutory interest
Dunning.settingsNotice: Amounts and the base rate are a commercial setting, not a legal release. The fee amount and the contractual basis for charging it to the community are still to be reviewed legally.
Dunning.presetsLoaded: Suggested values loaded. Please enter amounts and the base rate yourself.
Dunning.interestEnabledHint: Only selectable once a base rate is entered.
Dunning.interestBaseRate: Base rate (%, maintained by the operator, changes twice a year)
Dunning.overridesEmpty: No property deviates from the tenant default.
Dunning.inheritanceNotice: The tenant default applies to this property unless overridden here. Ticking "inherit from tenant" leaves that value empty so the property inherits it.
Dunning.tenantDefaultMissing: Save the tenant default first, then override properties.
Dunning.confirmRemoveOverride: Remove the property override? The property then inherits the tenant default again.
Dunning.overrideRemoved: Override removed. The property inherits the tenant default again.
Dunning.letterNotice: Dunning letters are created as drafts on the tenant letterhead only. Sending is locked; it happens outside the platform and is recorded with "Mark as sent".
Dunning.letterTextHint: Empty means the standard text of the level. An own text only replaces the request paragraph; the claim table (item, due date, amount, total) is always part of the letter. Placeholders: {placeholders}. {frist} yields a date only with a configured payment deadline, {bankverbindung} names an account only when one is released (otherwise "the account known to you").
Dunning.paymentDaysHint: Payment deadline per level in days: the dunning letter computes the payment date as letter date plus these days. Defaults: level 1 14 days, level 2 10 days, level 3 7 days. Without a value the letter asks for payment without a date.
Dunning.reminderNoFee: The payment reminder (level 1) never carries a fee or interest: fee from level must be at least 2 and the level 1 fee must be empty or 0.00 EUR.
Dunning.reminderNoFeeHint: Level 1 (payment reminder) never carries a fee or statutory interest; fees apply from level 2 at the earliest.

audit.revokeConfirm: End the board access to this engagement? Notes and questions are kept.
audit.grantHint: If the contact already has a portal account (for example as an owner), the board role is added to it. Otherwise an invitation is issued like for owners.

audit.notes: Notes and questions of the board

Automation.title: Automation
Automation.pageDescription: Rule engine: trigger (event or schedule), conditions and actions. Rules never post, pay, approve or send.
Automation.name: Name
Automation.triggerHelp: For example ticket.created. The list shows known event types.
Automation.noConditions: Without a condition the rule applies to every event of the trigger.
Automation.notifyTitle: Title (placeholders in curly braces allowed, for example ticket number or ticket title)
Automation.noMoneyHint: Rules create tickets, notify internally, set ticket fields, send webhooks, create e-mail and letter drafts and start AI proposals. No posting, no payment, no approval, no sending.
Automation.confirmDelete: Delete rule "{name}"? Its log entries are removed as well.
Automation.testRunHelp: The rule is checked against a sample event. Nothing is created, set or sent.
Automation.triggerMismatch: The event type does not match the rule trigger.
Automation.scheduleHelp: Time in Europe/Berlin. The rule runs exactly once per due moment; moments before activation are not caught up.
Automation.webhookSecretKeep: New secret (leave empty to keep the stored one)
Automation.webhookHelp: Signed call (HMAC SHA-256) with rule, event and ticket fields. Only https targets; private networks only with operator approval. The secret is stored encrypted and never shown.
Automation.mailDraftHelp: Only creates a draft in the ticket mailbox. Approval and sending stay manual (four eyes).
Automation.letterContact: Recipient (contact ID, empty = contact of the ticket)
Automation.letterContactRequired: Recipient (contact ID, required on a schedule)
Automation.letterDraftHelp: Renders the letter on the letterhead and stores it as a document. Nothing is sent.
Automation.aiTaskHelp: Starts an AI run through the gateway. The result is a proposal only; no posting, no approval.
Automation.expertJson: Rule core as JSON (trigger, schedule, conditions, actions)
Automation.expertHelp: Nested conditions are only possible here. Returning to the form requires a flat list of conditions.
Automation.nestedConditions: Nested conditions cannot be shown in the form. Please edit them in the expert view.
Automation.testRunSchedule: Schedule rule: the test run checks the actions for the next due moment without creating anything.

Dms.title: DMS and property takeover
Dms.intro: The digital property takeover (short name objektakte) keeps the property files in Google Drive: six folder structure per property, text recognition, classification, review centre, owner and tenant lists as well as requests to the previous management. It runs as a separate system and is connected to the CRM step by step.
Dms.stageText: Stage 1: jump per property via the property number. Stage 2: central sign in via the CRM. Stage 3: takeover status, open review cases and document list in the CRM as soon as the interface of the property takeover is available (plan M29).
Dms.folders: 01 Identification documents, 02 Master file, 03 Accounting, 04 Tenant file, 05 Owner file (per unit and owner with eleven subfolders), 06 Other (Unclear, Manual review, Duplicates, Not property related).
Dms.hint: The jump opens the search of the property takeover with the property number. A direct link per file follows with stage 3.
